name: coder
description: Secure environments for developers and their agents
one_liner: Gives every developer, and their AI coding assistants, a consistent, secure, cloud-hosted workspace instead of installing everything locally on their own laptop.
buyer: An engineering manager at a company with strict security requirements who needs to give contractors or remote developers safe access to code without it touching their personal laptops.
business_use_cases: A company with sensitive IP gives contractors access only through hosted, sandboxed dev environments that never let code leave company infrastructure.
A dev-tools consultancy sets up and manages cloud dev environments for engineering teams as a fixed monthly service.
A team running many AI coding agents in parallel gives each agent its own isolated, disposable environment instead of risking the shared local machine.

money_ideas.idea: Offer managed hosting and setup of secure dev environments for security-conscious companies
Sell a fixed-price 'contractor onboarding in a day' package built around it

steal_this: This weekend, set up a demo environment for a company that currently onboards contractors by mailing them a laptop, and pitch same-day secure access instead.
